name: Create and validate ZUGFeRD and Factur-X e-invoices with pdfRest

values.option: Allow replacement from XML if needed

parameters.formDescription: Create a hybrid invoice from CII XML, pair XML with an existing PDF, or validate a completed hybrid invoice. Pairing with Preserve selected can be rejected if pdfRest detects a mismatch. Allow replacement only if you agree to a new visual PDF generated from the XML. Upload one invoice per run and keep this tab open. Files are processed by pdfRest.

values.option: Approve after comparing PDF with source invoice

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{message:$json.errors.join(' ')+' Start a new submission with the corrected files. Nothing was created or released.'}}];

parameters.content:
## Start here
1. Install **@pdfrest/n8n-nodes-pdfrest 0.2.0 or newer**.
2. Connect your pdfRest API credential to all four pdfRest nodes. Choose the appropriate API region in the credential.
3. Run the upload form and select a task. Create needs CII XML; Pair needs XML + PDF; Validate needs only the completed hybrid PDF.
4. Review validation results and open the invoice PDF. Compare it with your source invoice before approving. Hold it if anything is unclear.
5. Download the ZIP. Its filename and READ-ME identify APPROVED, HELD or BLOCKED.

Requires an API plan with creation/validation access and visible validation details. No OpenAI, database or Drive account is needed.

Use the same credential in all four pdfRest nodes. For public Cloud, use https://api.pdfrest.com or https://eu-api.pdfrest.com. Internal testing keys require the matching environment. Verify unredacted validation access; a connection test alone does not confirm it.

Before production, configure background error notifications as described in Important notes. APPROVED, HELD, and BLOCKED are shown explicitly on the download screen. Inspect the ZIP report for full validation findings.

## How it works
**Check inputs → Create or validate → Independent validation → Human review → Audit ZIP**

**Create from XML:** pdfRest generates the visual PDF and packages the invoice XML.

**Pair XML with existing PDF:** Preserve requests keep the visual PDF only when the API accepts the comparison. A reported mismatch stops creation. Choosing Allow replacement explicitly permits regeneration from the canonical XML when needed; it does not guarantee the original design is retained.

**Validate existing hybrid PDF:** checks the uploaded completed invoice without modifying it.

Per the API contract, incomplete reverse comparison alone is non-blocking. A VALID, PDF/A-3 result with UNVERIFIED or NOT_APPLICABLE matching goes to human comparison; mismatches, errors, redacted and unknown results cannot be approved.

The audit ZIP records API validation and human disposition separately. Source files are retained when supplied. HELD and BLOCKED PDFs are marked NOT_RELEASED.

## Important notes
Use authoritative **CII XML** from your invoicing system; this workflow does not invent invoice values or convert UBL. Supported API profiles: MINIMUM, BASIC WL, BASIC and EN16931. EXTENDED and XRECHNUNG are unsupported in the supplied API spec.

Technical validation and human approval are separate. Approval never changes the API result. Self-entered reviewer names are an audit note, not authenticated identity. Protect the form through your deployment access controls.

Files go to pdfRest and may remain in n8n execution history; configure your retention policy. Review links may expire—rerun if needed.

This workflow does not send invoices, make payments, provide duplicate protection across runs or submit to tax authorities. Each file is limited to 20 MB. Correct XML in the source system and resubmit; no raw JSON editing is required.

Service failures show a step-specific explanation and then Stop And Error marks the execution failed. The original node uses a handled error branch; the final Stop And Error node is red. Full API findings cannot be recovered if the node discarded them. BLOCKED validation results retain a diagnostic ZIP and end as failed; a reviewer choosing HELD is not a technical failure.

**Background monitoring:** A failed execution does not send an alert by itself. Before production, create a separate Error Trigger workflow with your email or Slack notification node and select it in this workflow’s Settings → Error workflow. Include execution.error.message (invoice reference and reason), execution.lastNodeExecuted, and execution.url when available. Configure credentials and recipients there. Error Trigger notifications must be tested with a production execution; manual editor runs do not trigger them. HELD is an intentional reviewer decision and does not trigger failure alerts. No notification destination is configured in this template.
